_source: Pat Morgan, The Bearded Realtor / House Help Utah: Free Bonus 'Daily Tasks', Listing Course Weeks 5-6 (Mon-Fri), distilled in the bearded-realtor skill (playbooks/daily-engine.md). Structural rules are his; every number is his and can be changed in Settings.

reset.title: Block A: reset your head
reset.note: Before the household wakes. Focused, the whole list takes 45-60 minutes.

items.title: Three breaths
items.how: Breathe in positivity and confidence, hold a few seconds, breathe OUT negativity and self-doubt with a sound on the exhale. Three times. Use it again mid-day when stressed; if it does not clear, cold shower.

items.title: "I am" statements in the mirror
items.how: Present tense, eye to eye, until you believe them: "I am a listing agent." "I am selling N homes this year." Not business-only: anything you want to speak into existence.

items.title: Gratitude, out loud
Manifest 3-6-9
items.how: Write the goal in your phone Notes and say it out loud while you watch it being written: 3 times now, 6 at lunch, 9 at night. Pat: "this 369 thing is very important, so please keep doing it."

items.title: 30-minute walk, no input
items.how: No music, no podcast, no phone audio. Driving with the radio off counts. This is the idea generator, not a fitness slot: the ideas that surface around minute 30 ARE the videos.

items.title: Act on whatever surfaced
items.how: Capture it below and do it, no matter how weird it seems. The filter is the failure mode (the creepy-building video did 50,000 views).

volume.title: Block B: the volume
volume.note: The part that produces business. Every day, before anything else in the business starts.

items.title: Post {{posts}} pieces of content
items.how: Reels, not stories. Try to have your face in all of them; people follow the person, then discover the business. Every video ends on the seller-program card. Spread across platforms per the cadence table so nothing throttles.

items.title: {{marketplace}}
items.how: One home per day on Facebook Marketplace. It does not have to be your listing. Seller-program graphic as photos 2-3.

items.title: Add 10 friends on every platform
items.how: Manual, never automated. Stay under each platform's daily cap (table below); Facebook is the most throttle-sensitive. Prefer people with mutual friends.

items.title: Reach out to 10 people
items.how: Call, DM, text or email, in the channel THEY prefer. Three of the ten are pure gratitude or a compliment, no ask. Start with today's birthdays (a birthday is a zero-pretext reason to message anyone), then top up from the pipeline.

items.title: 1% better than yesterday
items.how: One sentence: what is 1% better today. Then put out fires, go on listing appointments, return calls, make more content.

monday.title: Monday: pipeline hygiene + deadlines
monday.note: Mondays are the busiest day: everyone is catching up. Plan for interruptions, not deep work.

items.title: Review every contract deadline in the next 7 days; confirm every appointment is set
Follow up with every potential LISTING, in the channel they prefer. Any excuse to touch base (go live this week? photographer is five days out?). Do not be pushy.
Follow up with every potential BUYER. Stagnant? Open their search, send something even approximately right: "this popped up, thought of you."
Clean up the weekend: update remarks, strip OPEN HOUSE wording from the MLS and all marketing
Weekly seller update to every active listing by 4 PM (even a quiet week)

tuesday.title: Tuesday: listings + price movement
tuesday.note: Pat calls this one of his least favorite parts of the job; it is scheduled precisely because nobody does it voluntarily. Consistency beats huge gains in one day. Do not spend tomorrow's energy today.

items.title: Market update on EVERY current listing: comps by status (active / under contract / sold) in the price band, showings vs the 1-2 per week benchmark, three pricing options. Get the price reductions.
Team meeting (if you have a team)

wednesday.title: Wednesday: the weekend setup
wednesday.note: The hinge of the week: structured work drops from here, appointments rise.

items.title: Plan the weekend open houses from new listings and fresh price drops
Re-market every listing and upcoming open house on Marketplace and social

thursday.title: Thursday: the content build day
thursday.note: Thursdays are slow, which is why the content gets made today. You still post your normal 3. Coaching call at noon MST.

items.title: MAKE 10 reels today (build them, do not post them). Pull from the idea queue; run every hook through the Content agent.
Coaching call, noon MST

friday.title: Friday: the posting day
friday.note: Finish the ENTIRE non-negotiable list first, then start posting. Today the daily list changes: 10 posts, and Marketplace = the open houses.

items.title: Post the 10 reels, one every hour from 8 AM, spread across platforms per the cadence table
Post this weekend's open houses to Facebook Marketplace

saturday.title: Saturday: recover in place
saturday.note: Missed something this week? Slide it here. Open houses today (verify Saturday still outperforms Sunday in your market).

items.title: Hold the open houses; log traffic

sunday.title: Reset day
sunday.note: A genuine reset, not a light work day. Family, no work. Pat has burned out dozens of times; the streak survives because of the stop. Overflow moves to Monday.

recovery.missed_today: Not a failed program. Tomorrow is a new day. Let it go and restart.
recovery.missed_weekday_task: Recover in place: slide the work onto Saturday.
recovery.week_collapsed: Restart Monday. It is a loop, not a syllabus.
recovery.ceiling: Do the core list first. Only then, if energy is left, add more. Do not spend tomorrow's energy today.

failure_modes: Stuck? Go for a walk or meditate.
Feeling low? Work out, cold shower, cold plunge.
Then: put out fires, go on more listing appointments, return calls, make more content.
